selected_evidence.requirement: Worker runs as inventory-worker and automatically recovers after failure
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline was captured, the one-shot failure was deliberately triggered, and the journal shows exit status 1 followed by systemd's scheduled restart. The replacement worker was active under inventory-worker.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot ID and service health were captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with a changed boot ID. The system was running, the service remained enabled and active with Restart=on-failure, and the worker process and state were healthy under inventory-worker.

cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker with automatic failure recovery
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-flaky-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
NoNewPrivileges=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
